prompt: Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Set headings in Archivo and reading text in Libre Baskerville; direct grotesque heading with measured reading serif. Use Spectrum 2-4: page #1D1716, text #F7F5F3, accent #B6E58A, secondary surface #253733, text on accent #111111. Use body 18px, heading 28px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 32px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
